structuredContent.governing_intent: Create a single reviewable CANDIDATE architecture/design document at docs/architecture/pre-python-gate/context-and-memory.md for the Pre-Python gate, carrying forward already-decided Context Engineering and memory/state/evidence separation material without implementing code or asserting Founder approval.
structuredContent.summary: The work packet is a bounded documentation/design task with explicit scope, exclusions, source authorities, acceptance criteria, and verification expectations. It is cohesive: the context model and memory/state/evidence separation are related architectural inputs that should be reconciled in one candidate artifact rather than split into separate independent decisions. The task explicitly limits changes to the candidate document and local packet/readiness evidence, prohibits implementation/source/config/runtime changes, and requires unresolved Founder decisions to be recorded rather than invented.
implementation_unknowns: Exact locations and wording of cited source sections must be mapped into the candidate document without independently verifying beyond supplied/local baselines during this assessment.
The author will need to choose a document structure that makes the source/invariant mapping, contract semantics, examples, limitations, and unresolved decisions reviewable.
The candidate must distinguish binding Founder-approved material from candidate synthesis and from historical Node evidence that is not Python capability proof.
The independent content review process/checklist must be applied to the completed document content, but the supplied task gives enough criteria to proceed.
structuredContent.verification_assessment: Acceptance is observable from the resulting document: it can be checked for the required six context kinds, static/dynamic boundaries, role/phase assembly, progressive retrieval, provenance/version/budget/outcome linkage, seven separate memory/state/evidence classes, verifier exclusion of producer private reasoning, no generic memory bucket, source/invariant mapping, successful and failing examples, scope limitations, and explicit unresolved Founder decisions. One independent review verdict is meaningful because the output is a single candidate design artifact with traceable source sections and local evidence; no runtime regression verification is required for this documentation-only packet.
material_risks: The document could accidentally present candidate synthesis as adopted architecture or Founder-approved authority.
The author could over-invent new semantics instead of carrying forward cited decisions and labeling unresolved cross-document choices.
Context Engineering and memory/state/evidence terms may overlap; poor separation could blur ownership, lifetime, retrieval, provenance, or verifier-independence boundaries.
Historical Node evidence may be overstated as proof of Python behavior if not clearly scoped.
Changing files outside the allowed documentation/packet evidence paths would violate the stated authority.
structuredContent.next_action: Proceed to draft the single candidate design document and local packet/readiness evidence within the authorized paths, preserving source traceability and explicitly labeling candidate material and unresolved Founder decisions.
structuredContent.rationale: The controlling condition is readiness, not approval of the architecture. The task supplies clear governing intent, bounded authority, explicit exclusions, acceptance criteria, and verification expectations. Remaining uncertainties are implementation/document-authoring research, not material owner-intent questions. The context and memory/state/evidence material forms one cohesive architectural candidate artifact with localized rework if review finds gaps, and the supplied text asserts necessary local source baselines exist, so no external prerequisite is established as unavailable.
